name: Web Demo 3 · Human approval of AI-drafted replies

parameters.content:
## Approve AI-drafted customer replies

### How it works
A customer message enters through the app. A free model classifies it, and a paid model drafts a reply. Both outputs must pass validation before the request is saved as pending.

The app receives the actual request reference while the workflow waits for a human decision. A reviewer can approve, edit or reject the draft. The decision is recorded first. Approved or edited requests then load the final text from the database, send it by email and notify Telegram. Rejected requests record the reason without sending a reply.

A separate scheduled lane checks for overdue pending requests every 15 minutes. It alerts Telegram and postpones the next reminder by 60 minutes. Silence leaves the request pending; it does not automatically reject it.

### Setup steps
1. Configure Postgres, Groq, OpenAI, Gmail and Telegram credentials.
2. Match the Wait node’s Header Auth credential with the app backend.
3. Keep resume URLs on the backend; never expose them to the browser.
4. Complete a clean end-to-end run before enabling customer traffic.

## Receive the customer message
Accept the customer’s message from the app. After the pending request is saved, return its actual reference in the same HTTP request, so the reviewer can find the correct item.

## Classify and draft safely
A free model identifies topic, urgency and whether a person is needed. A paid model drafts the reply. Both outputs must pass validation; a failure stops processing before a pending request is created.

## Save and wait for a decision
Save the pending request and its resume URL, then wait for a human decision. The app backend uses that URL with Header Auth; the browser never receives it. Without a decision, the request remains pending.

## Record the decision and deliver
Record the reviewer’s decision before delivery. Approved or edited requests load final text from the database, send the email and notify Telegram. Rejected requests record the reason without sending a reply.

## Remind the reviewer of overdue requests
Run independently every 15 minutes. Check the database for overdue pending requests, alert Telegram and delay the next reminder by 60 minutes. This checks request age, not whether the waiting execution is still alive.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'openai/gpt-oss-20b', temperature: 0, max_completion_tokens: 800, reasoning_effort: 'low', include_reasoning: false, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are a customer-service triage assistant. Today is ' + $now.setZone('America/Sao_Paulo').toFormat('dd/MM/yyyy') + ' (timezone America/Sao_Paulo). Resolve relative time expressions such as "today", "tomorrow", "this week" or "by Friday" against that date: a deadline that is already past or is within 48 hours raises urgency; a far-away date does not. Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else - no prose, no code fences. Schema: {"subject": one of "warranty"|"exchange"|"delivery"|"billing"|"product_info"|"complaint"|"other", "urgency": one of "low"|"medium"|"high", "needs_human": boolean, "summary": one short sentence in the same language as the customer message}. Never invent facts that are not in the message. If something is unclear, choose "other" and set needs_human to true.' }, { role: 'user', content: $('Receive customer message').item.json.body.mensagem } ] }) }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO aprovacoes_pendentes (origem, remetente_nome, remetente_email, mensagem_cliente, recebido_em, assunto, urgencia, rascunho_ia, resume_url, resumo, request_id) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::timestamptz, $6, CASE $7 WHEN 'low' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'high' THEN 3 END, $8, $9, $10, $11) ON CONFLICT (request_id) WHERE request_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET request_id = EXCLUDED.request_id RETURNING id, resume_url, status;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Receive customer message').first().json.body.origem, $('Receive customer message').first().json.body.remetente.nome, $('Receive customer message').first().json.body.remetente.email, $('Receive customer message').first().json.body.mensagem, $('Receive customer message').first().json.body.recebido_em, $json.subject, $json.urgency, $json.draft, $execution.resumeUrl, $json.summary, $('Receive customer message').first().json.body.request_id || null] }}

parameters.query: UPDATE aprovacoes_pendentes SET status = CASE $2::text WHEN 'approved' THEN 'aprovado' WHEN 'adjusted' THEN 'ajustado' WHEN 'rejected' THEN 'recusado' END, texto_final = CASE $2::text WHEN 'approved' THEN rascunho_ia WHEN 'adjusted' THEN $3::text END, motivo_recusa = CASE $2::text WHEN 'rejected' THEN $4::text END, decidido_por = $5::text, decidido_em = now(), houve_correcao = ($2::text = 'adjusted') WHERE id = $1::bigint AND status = 'pendente' RETURNING id, status, houve_correcao, decidido_por;

SELECT count(*)::int AS total,
       COALESCE(string_agg(
         format('#%s %s (%s) - %s min',
           id,
           replace(replace(replace(remetente_nome, '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'),
           replace(replace(replace(COALESCE(assunto, 'no subject'), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'),
           round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - criado_em))/60)),
         E'\n' ORDER BY urgencia DESC, criado_em ASC
       ), '') AS lista
FROM aprovacoes_pendentes
WHERE status = 'pendente'
  AND now() > COALESCE(prazo_aviso, criado_em + interval '15 minutes');

-- Pushes the next warning one hour ahead for everything just alerted,
-- so the same item is not reported again on every 15-minute tick.
UPDATE aprovacoes_pendentes
SET prazo_aviso = now() + interval '60 minutes'
WHERE status = 'pendente'
  AND now() > COALESCE(prazo_aviso, criado_em + interval '15 minutes')
RETURNING id, prazo_aviso;

SELECT id, remetente_nome, remetente_email, texto_final, status, decidido_por, houve_correcao FROM aprovacoes_pendentes WHERE id = $1::bigint AND status IN ('aprovado','ajustado') AND texto_final IS NOT NULL;
